mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2.5% YoY signals strengthening aggregate demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite strong GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low FEDFUNDS rate (< 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in accommodation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in UNRATE below 7% signals improving labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite low UNRATE.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO exceeding 1.2% MoM signals strengthening industrial production, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during late-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of triggered late-cycle instances despite strong INDPRO growth.

mechanism_narrative: The joint behavior of HOUST and RSAFS, where both increase by more than 5% YoY, signals broadening demand, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both HOUST and RSAFS YoY growth > 5%
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in broadening demand periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in FEDFUNDS (> 1.5% in 3 months) signals monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of triggered tightening instances despite rapid FEDFUNDS increase.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of a low UNRATE (< 8%) and increasing PAYEMS (> 1% MoM) signals a strong labor market, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, but only during mid-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of triggered mid-cycle instances despite strong labor market signals.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained high GDPC1 growth rate (> 3% YoY for 2 consecutive quarters) signals robust aggregate demand, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, regardless of the regime.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY growth > 3% for 2 consecutive quarters
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in robust demand periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
